commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=70757f678f0433ffa7dbbd27b4a145bd7d2727da
git fetch origin --prune
git checkout main
git reset --hard origin/main
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"
bash scripts/verify_host.sh
for branch in \
  milestone/phase2b-proven-s22-20260916 \
  milestone/phase2c-shizuku-live-proven-20260916 \
  milestone/phase2d-failsafe-proven-s22-20260918 \
  work/phase1-live-call-probes \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker-2 \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker-3; do
  git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$branch" origin/main
done
git push origin --delete \
  milestone/phase2b-proven-s22-20260916 \
  milestone/phase2c-shizuku-live-proven-20260916 \
  milestone/phase2d-failsafe-proven-s22-20260918 \
  work/phase1-live-call-probes \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker-2 \
  tmp-do-not-use-cleanup-marker-3
git fetch origin --prune
REMOTE_HEADS=$(git ls-remote --heads origin | awk '{sub("refs/heads/","",$2); print $2}' | sort)
printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_HEADS"
test "$REMOTE_HEADS" = $'agent-control\nmain'
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo main_cleanup_gate_green=true
